consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: preventive action - alarm philosophy conformance on TK-7103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on TK-7103, LT-7103 and PSV-7103 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating an impoundment, specifically inspecting embankments and instrumentation. TK-7103 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 15 October 2023 a corrective action on TK-7103, LT-7103 and PSV-7103 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
